newsitem.title: USA: Lamar completes notes tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Lamar completes notes tender offer.

text.p: Lamar Advertising Co said on Wednesday it successfully completed its tender offer and consent solicitation for its outstanding 11 percent senior secured notes due May 15, 2003.

As of the November 25 expiration date, about $98.8 million in total principal amount of notes had been tendered, or about 98.8 percent of the $100 million aggregate principal amount of outstanding notes, the company said.
